android.meta.title: TypeWhisper for Android (Beta)
android.meta.description: Join the TypeWhisper beta for Android: private speech-to-text with on-device AI, a voice keyboard, and writing profiles.
android.label: Beta
android.title: TypeWhisper for Android
android.lede: Private speech-to-text for Android with on-device AI, a voice keyboard, and writing profiles.
android.join.label: Join the beta
android.join.title: How to join the beta
android.join.lede: The beta runs through Google Play. Two steps, and updates then arrive like any other app update.
android.join.step1.title: Join the Google Group
android.join.step1.text: Any Google account works. The group only serves as the tester list; no emails are posted there.
android.join.step2.title: Opt in and install from Google Play
android.join.step2.text: Open the testing page with the Google account that joined the group, tap Become a tester, then install TypeWhisper from Google Play. After joining the group, it can take a few minutes until the page lets you in.
android.join.step2.soon: The Google Play testing page opens once the beta starts. Join the group now so you can opt in right away.
android.try.label: What to try
android.try.title: What to try
android.try.lede: Everything below is in the beta. Try what you would use every day.
android.try.item1: On-device dictation with Parakeet (25 European languages) or Whisper (99 languages).
android.try.item2: Optional cloud speech engines with your own API key.
android.try.item3: The TypeWhisper keyboard in any app, with a QWERTZ or QWERTY layout.
android.try.item4: Writing profiles: clean up, message, email, note, calendar event, checklist, summary, translation, or your own.
android.try.item5: The Inbox for quick dictations from the quick settings tile, the widget, an app shortcut, or the assist gesture.
android.try.item7: Premium: the email and calendar profiles, live transcription with Nemotron, and speaker detection.
android.notice.label: Beta notice
android.notice.title: Beta notice
android.notice.p1: This is a beta, so expect bugs and rough edges.
android.notice.p2: Please stay opted in for at least 14 days. Google only allows the public release after 12 testers have stayed in the beta for 14 days.
android.notice.p3: Send feedback in the app under Settings → Send feedback, on Discord, or by email.
android.notice.discordText: Questions, bugs, and ideas with other testers.
android.notice.emailText: Bug reports and anything you would rather not post publicly.
android.requirements.title: Requirements
android.requirements.text: Android 10 or later and a Google account for Google Play.
